description: This file defines the TogetherAIRerank class, which implements a reranking API interface supporting synchronous and asynchronous calls for the Together AI rerank service. It includes methods to send rerank requests, handle responses, and manage dependencies related to HTTP clients and data transformation.

classes.name: TogetherAIRerank
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLM to provide reranking capabilities via the Together AI API, supporting both sync and async operations.

methods.name: RerankResponse rerank( self, model: str, api_key: str, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, _is_async: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Performs a rerank request to the Together AI API, either synchronously or asynchronously based on the _is_async flag, and returns the rerank response.

methods.name: RerankResponse async_rerank( self, request_data_dict: Dict[str, Any], api_key: str, )
methods.description: An asynchronous method to perform rerank requests to the API, returning a RerankResponse object.
